title: models.v1
description: The model catalog. Two shapes: Catalog is what the operator declares (VEXA_MODEL_CATALOG, agent-api's environment) — the providers this deployment reaches and the models it offers on each; ModelList is what agent-api serves to the terminal and the MCP (GET /api/models) — the models one person may pick, with no endpoint, credential or request setting in it. A credential is only ever a reference (secret_ref), never a value (P14).

ModelId.description: A catalog id: what a chat, a routine and a person's default name. Stable across releases of the catalog; never the provider's own model id.

ProviderKey.description: The operator's name for one provider declaration (e.g. lab-vllm, openrouter).

Adapter.description: Which provider adapter resolves a model on this provider. openai_compatible: a self-hosted vLLM / llama.cpp / LiteLLM or any OpenAI-compatible gateway, on the openai-agent harness. openrouter: OpenRouter, on the openai-agent harness (/api/v1) or the claude-code harness (its Anthropic-compatible /api), as the provider declares. anthropic: Anthropic directly, by API key or by the deployment's subscription, on the claude-code harness. custom: the person's own Settings → Models endpoint, gated by VEXA_MODEL_BASE_URL_ALLOW.

Harness.description: The agent harness that drives a model.

Access.description: Who may pick a model: everyone on the deployment, or instance admins only.

Capabilities.description: What the model can do on this route. streaming and context_tokens reach the openai-agent harness; a model without tool calling cannot drive an agent turn and is refused at boot.

ExtraBody.description: Server-specific request fields merged into every openai-agent request (e.g. a self-hosted Qwen's chat_template_kwargs). Never a credential.

Provider.description: One provider declaration. Which fields apply depends on the adapter; agent-api refuses a declaration whose fields its adapter does not take.

base_url.description: openai_compatible only: the endpoint's OpenAI-compatible root (http or https, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8000/v1).

auth.description: none: a keyless endpoint. secret: the value secret_ref names. subscription (anthropic only): the deployment's own Claude subscription.

secret_ref.description: A REFERENCE to the credential, never the value: env:NAME names a variable in agent-api's environment, delivered from the deployment's secret store.

model.description: The model's id at the provider (e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-32B, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5). Absent for a custom entry, whose model is the person's own setting.

default.description: The model a person runs on before they pick one. At most one entry.

Catalog.description: The operator's declaration (VEXA_MODEL_CATALOG). Unset or empty: no catalog, and every turn runs on the deployment's model and each person's Settings → Models exactly as without one.

ModelListEntry.description: One model as a person sees it: no endpoint, no credential, no request setting.

default.description: true on the catalog's own default entry

ModelList.description: GET /api/models: the models the caller may pick. default is the model the caller runs on before picking (their own default, else the catalog's, else the first listed; null when the list is empty). selected is the named chat's own pick, present when the request named a chat (null: the chat follows the default).
